marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Xifang musilin yu yisilan de weilai = Covering Islamic Countries by Chinese Mainland Media (2001-2015)

Author trying to create the values and life style of Muslims in Western Society. Author suggested Muslims to go back to the Origins of Islam, to refresh their understanding on Islam's core values and develop their future following the core values, and remove the improper mindset and attitudes, seeking the relationships and balance in their life and believes. Author thinks that Muslim in western society should stop being limited by the typical political identity, and advance to seek the values of Muslims to the society, contributes as a civilian and fight for the justice in the society they living.
